subject: Acme FinTech — procurement & vendor onboarding next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-fintech.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme FinTech — discovery recap & procurement next steps

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today — great to meet the team and learn more about your fraud-detection pilot and the low-latency inference needs you described. Per our call, I wanted to recap decisions and the procurement path so we can keep momentum.

Summary of what we covered:
- Primary use case: low-latency model scoring at inference for real-time fraud signals (p99 <= 35ms target).
- Expected volume: 50–80 qps steady, with spikes to 200 qps during peak hours.
- Decision criteria: latency, per-token cost, data residency, and SOC2/compliance requirements.
- Stakeholders: Engineering (Priya), Procurement (Daniel), Security/Compliance (TBD), and your Business Sponsor (Sandeep).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the procurement owner and preferred invoicing process (PO vs. credit-card)? Daniel, are you the person for PO + vendor onboarding?
2) Priya — can you share the expected pilot timeline (start date) and any compliance packet items we should prepare?
3) I've attached our standard SLA and a vendor onboarding form to speed vendor setup. If helpful, we can also share a short one-pager on quantization & cost controls tailored to your qps profile.

Attachments: redwood_sla-2026.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx

I'll follow up with the internal team to prep the billing & contract info once we have procurement contact details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0137
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme FinTech — discovery recap & procurement next steps

Thanks Marissa, great recap.

Confirming procurement owner: Daniel Park (cc'd) will own PO + vendor onboarding. We typically do an initial 3-month pilot with a PO (net 30) and then convert to a committed contract if metrics look good. Security will run a standard vendor security review; I expect to loop in our security lead (Maya R.) next week — we'll send any questionnaire items.

Pilot timeline: tentative start week of March 22, 2026.

Daniel, can you confirm the following when you have a moment?
- Preferred vendor onboarding contact and email for accounting
- Any required insurance limits or vendor terms that we need to be aware of
- Typical PO lead time at Acme

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
Head of Engineering, Risk & Signals | Acme FinTech
priya.singh@acme-fintech.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme FinTech — procurement owner confirmed (Daniel Park)

Forwarding Priya's confirmation — procurement owner is Daniel Park and pilot kickoff is tentatively the week of March 22.

Neha / Michael — can you prep the vendor onboarding packet and a draft SOW/invoice template? Specifics we should include:
- Pilot scope: real-time scoring up to 80 qps steady, 200 qps bursts; p99 target 35ms.
- Billing model: pilot on usage-based billing with PO (net 30), contact details will be provided by Daniel.
- Required docs: SOC 2 report, vendor security questionnaire, standard SLA (attached).

I've attached redwood_sla-2026.pdf and vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx — please fill the onboarding form fields we need for Acme (billing address, tax id, insurance, invoicing email). Also, include a short note on expected billing cadence and point estimates for pilot spend (rough order of magnitude for a 3-month pilot).

If we can have the packet ready by EOD next Tuesday (Mar 9), I'll send to Daniel to accelerate PO issuance.

Thanks,
Marissa
